backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access control, user profiles, and request/technician/inventory/feedback data models with CRUD-style helpers and validation checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two logo‑related frontend features with affected files, components, test IDs, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file including pages, components, hooks, utils, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes and applying global background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point providing the root div and loading the main client script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the TanStack Router with routes for home, requests, and admin pages using PageLayout as the root layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/InventoryS: Inventory management UI for listing, adding, updating items, and highlighting low‑stock parts.
frontend/src/components/admin/SparesUsag: Form to log spare-parts usage by technicians for specific service tickets.
frontend/src/components/admin/Technician: Displays customer feedback with technician filtering and average rating calculation.
Builds technician workload stats from requests and displays assigned, completed, and pending counts.
Reusable dropdown component for selecting a technician from fetched technician data.
Interface to view and add technicians using a form and a technicians table.
frontend/src/components/admin/UsageRepor: Displays spare‑part usage statistics by aggregating inventory logs and showing a sorted table with loading states.
frontend/src/components/CategoryGrid.tsx: Grid component rendering clickable service category cards that navigate to the registration page.
frontend/src/components/feedback/Feedbac: Provides a star‑rating feedback form that submits feedback via a mutation and shows success or error states.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/PageLayout.tsx: Overall app layout including the header, main content outlet, and footer with business info and social links.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: Wrapper component that shows a sign‑in prompt when unauthenticated and renders children when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive site header with branding, navigation links, admin-aware menu items, and a mobile sheet menu.
frontend/src/constants/branding.ts: Exports centralized branding info including logo path, alt text, company name, and phone.
frontend/src/constants/serviceCategories: Defines service category metadata with images and helper functions to look up categories by ID or name.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login state, stored identities, and provides context for authentication throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for interacting with backend requests, profiles, admin checks, feedback, and inventory data.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes with design tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard showing filtered service requests with search, status filters, technician assignment, and admin management tools.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Admin login page using Internet Identity and redirects authorized admins to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Public homepage with branding, service categories, features, and a call‑to‑action to book a service request.
frontend/src/pages/MyRequestsPage.tsx: Displays the logged‑in user's service requests with loading, error, empty states, and navigation to create or view details.
frontend/src/pages/RegisterRequestPage.t: Form for authenticated users to create a new service or spares request with validation and submission logic.
frontend/src/pages/RequestDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific service request with status, device info, and optional feedback form.
frontend/src/pages/RequestSuccessPage.ts: Displays a confirmation page showing a submitted request ID with navigation buttons to home or request details.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Lists service categories with descriptions and images, allowing users to navigate to the service request form.
frontend/src/pages/TrackStatusPage.tsx: Provides a form to search for a request by ticket ID and phone, showing status details or errors and optional feedback form.
Computes basic counts of request statuses and unassigned requests from a list.
frontend/src/utils/adminRequestsView.ts: Provides helpers for searching, filtering, and sorting request lists based on status, category, type, and creation time.
frontend/src/utils/brand.ts: Converts between brand enums and strings and defines common brand options.
frontend/src/utils/csvExport.ts: Generates and downloads a CSV file containing request data, escaping fields and formatting timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Formats bigint timestamps into readable or short date strings.
frontend/src/utils/requestStatus.ts: Maps request statuses to user-facing labels and UI style variants.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles extracting, storing, retrieving, and clearing URL or session-stored parameters for navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the appliance service website, feature list, architectural notes, and image optimization requirements.
